reason: I already have a POS, a card terminal and a QR menu, and I count cash and card totals myself every night. A second payment stream with its own fees and its own report is more work for me and my staff, and a free trial doesn't change that.
objection: Will my guests, mostly tourists and older regulars, really scan and pay by phone instead of handing a card to the waiter, and how do I reconcile those payments with my POS each night without double work?
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged straight into my existing POS so QR payments closed the bill there automatically and showed up in the same nightly total, with a transaction fee no higher than my terminal's.
